periods.summary: Alice saves Or-Gaule when he begs for his life, striking Stella and openly betraying the Vermillion team. She knows the act is unforgivable but chooses to protect her younger brother over honor, country, and public judgment. Ikki stays behind to fight her so Stella can pursue Or-Gaule. Alice's Invincible Armor nullifies Ikki's ordinary sword techniques, and Regeneration Overdose permanently strengthens her body each time it is damaged, letting her outpace Amatsu Raikou and force Ikki onto defense. She realizes Ikki is using her urgency to save Or-Gaule against her: if she fights safely for ten more minutes she will win, but Or-Gaule may die first. Remembering the first time she held Or-Gaule's hand, Alice chooses the risky short decisive clash. She trusts Invincible Armor to slow Oikage long enough to kill Ikki afterward, but misunderstands Oikage as speed rather than a fate-cutting result. Ikki's final secret sword cuts through her armor and body. Regeneration Overdose then makes her over-strengthened body self-destruct once the armor's healing is gone. As she dies in Ikki's arms, Alice tries to release him from guilt, but he refuses to forget her and promises to carry her pain in his sword. She cannot hear the words but feels his warmth and dies peacefully, thanking him. Later Levi Ascaride sends Ikki gratitude, and Stella preserves some of Or-Gaule's ashes so the siblings can be buried together.

key_events.summary: Fights Ikki with Invincible Armor and Regeneration Overdose, then dies after Oikage.
Her love for Or-Gaule becomes Stella's final rebuttal to his self-pity.
Levi Ascaride thanks Ikki for letting Alice end without regret.
